title: Selected Systems
lead: Two runnable systems for trustworthy intelligence under constraint: deterministic, auditable measurements first; models held at the edge and behind gates.

projects.name: Verifile
projects.hook: Evidence-first SEC filing change analysis. Numbers are computed in Python, not invented by a model.
projects.body: Compares a company's two most recent comparable 10-Ks from SEC XBRL. Figures are deterministic with auditable provenance; a model is optional and gated, never the source of the numbers.
projects.disclaimer: Research aid only, not investment advice.

projects.name: Edge‑Intelligent AR Viewer
projects.hook: Browser AR and quantized classification that never leave your device.
projects.body: On-device WebGL/WebXR AR plus quantized MobileNetV2 classification. Camera and inference stay local; runs offline after load.
